delivery.outcome: Decompose _apply_plan_tickets in src/koru/autonomy/todo2code_discovery.py into focused helper functions (_relative_plans_path, _plan_identity, _resolve_plan_priority, _enrich_plan_scaffold, _dispatch_plan_task) to eliminate the god-function code smell and reduce CC from 14 to 5 while preserving identical deduplication, usefulness ranking, task creation, and error handling semantics.
nonGoals: Changing plan usefulness scoring or ranking algorithms
Altering task priority mapping or labels
Refactoring other discovery functions like _ticket_scaffold or run_todo2code_discovery

architecture.decision: Extract plan path resolution, identity extraction, priority mapping, scaffold enrichment, and task dispatch into small single-responsibility helper functions with CC <= 4.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the inline _apply_plan_tickets implementation.

validation.evidence: Cyclomatic complexity of _apply_plan_tickets and all new helpers is <= 5.
All existing todo2code discovery tests pass unchanged.
